282259585.description:
Wahl Eversharp
Gold Filled
15.41 grams
Vintage Wahl Eversharp mechanical pencil crafted in gold filled metal with an engine-turned chevron pattern throughout the barrel. Designed with a classic ring-top chatelaine loop, this early 20th-century writing instrument combines Art Deco styling with utilitarian functionality.
Engine-turned chevron and pinstripe pattern on the barrel
Ring-top suspension loop for chatelaine, ribbon, or pocket chain carry
Extendable internal mechanism with dual-rod structure
Measures approximately 4 3/8 inches in total length
Marked Wahl Eversharp Gold Filled PAT Made In U.S.A.
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage condition. Shows surface wear, fine scratching, and patina consistent with age and previous use. Verdigris oxidation is present around the top ring loop fixture. Imprinted Wahl Eversharp markings on the upper barrel. Lead is present at the writing tip.
Only includes what is shown in pictures, any accessories or items not shown but described cannot be guaranteed to be included with the lot.

You are purchasing a "Mixed Rock and Mineral Collection Lot with Agate Slices" in "Used" condition.
Colorful mixed lot of rocks, minerals, and agate slices—perfect for collectors, crafters, educators, or anyone who loves natural stone. This unique bundle includes a wide variety of pieces, from rough rock specimens to polished tumbled stones and vibrant agate slices. Highlights: - Assorted tumbled stones in multiple colors - Rough rocks and mineral pieces with natural texture - Several polished agate slices in bright and neutral tones - One stone display box with polished stones - One larger stone block with an animal outline and info card - One bag filled with mixed stones for sorting or crafting Great for rock enthusiasts, classroom kits, craft projects, or decorating bowls, terrariums, and shelves. The bag of mixed stones shows no visible tears but is creased from handling. The carved rectangular stone block and other larger pieces show small nicks and surface scratches consistent with age and use.
